name: Detective Lawrence &... The Case of the Missing Ragdoll!
source:
Jacob's Missing! It's up to Lawrence, prompted by the reward of a sweet kiss from Topaz, to find him! Can he do it?...Maybe.

[From [url=http://waveripple.deviantart.com/art/Monsterful-Visual-NovelDownload-in-Description-455992365]DeviantArt[/url]]

雅各布失踪了！劳伦斯在黄玉甜蜜的吻的激励下，必须找到他！他能做到吗？……也许吧。
